instrument: Raton resolution for a data center moratorium (rejected)
summary: City Commission voted 3-2 to reject a resolution pausing business licenses and zoning approvals for data centers; dissenters cited existing utility safeguards and no current proposal. A resident submitted 477 signatures in support.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Weekly Briefing, Sept 21-24, 2026 (digest), citing local reporting (KRTN)
